queries.exists: SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name LIKE 'Rtools %' AND publisher = 'The R Foundation';
queries.patched: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name LIKE 'Rtools %' AND publisher = 'The R Foundation' AND version_compare(version, '4.5.6768') < 0);
queries.open: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM processes WHERE LOWER(name) = 'rtools.exe');
